assumptions.text: Pre-shipment inspection priced at $268 per man-day.
assumptions.label: sourced

assumptions.text: AQL 0 / 2.5 / 4.0 for critical / major / minor is the usual consumer-goods setting; agree it with the buyer and factory.
assumptions.label: estimate

assumptions.text: One inspector checks about 100 units per day including functional tests.
assumptions.label: estimate

sample_size.label: estimate
sample_size.source_or_assumption: Per ISO 2859-1 table (edition not verified): Table I code letter K for lot 1,201–3,200, level General II, Table II-A

defects.description: Battery pack shows swelling, leakage, damaged enclosure, or abnormal heating during inspection.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e6 (Stationary solar battery pack with integrated battery management system)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; controlled charge/discharge test with temperature monitoring — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Grid-tie inverter or battery inverter/charger has exposed live parts, damaged insulation, arcing, or abnormal overheating during operation.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e2 (Single-phase grid-tie string inverter, approx. 5 kW, MPPT) / BOM e7 (Battery inverter/charger compatible with the existing grid-tie system) / Certification: EN IEC 62109-1:2010 and EN IEC 62109-2:2011
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; electrical safety and functional test — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: PV DC isolator or AC disconnect fails to isolate its circuit, or shows damaged contacts, overheating, or arcing.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e3 (PV DC isolator, voltage/current rated for array) / BOM e4 (AC protection and disconnect assembly)
defects.check_method: Operate disconnects and verify electrical isolation; inspect for heat damage — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: PV DC cable or connectors are damaged, incompatible, loose, or show exposed conductors that could cause shock or fire.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e5 (PV-rated DC cable and compatible module connectors) / Electronics block b2 (DC isolation and cabling)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; connector compatibility and continuity check — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Installed rails deviate from alignment by more than 5 mm, module gaps are outside 17–23 mm, or roof-edge margin is less than 450 mm.
defects.spec_ref: BOM m1 (Anodised aluminium mounting rails) / Part p2 (PV modules) / Tolerance: Rail alignment ±5 mm / Tolerance: Module gap 20 mm ±3 mm / Tolerance: Roof-edge margin ≥ 450 mm
defects.check_method: Measure alignment, module gaps, and roof-edge margin with tape or gauge — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Modules are cracked, delaminated, or fail to produce output during the functional check.
defects.spec_ref: Part p2 (PV modules) / BOM e1 (Monocrystalline PV module, approx. 450 W, framed)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; test module output under controlled illumination — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Mounting feet, clamps, or fasteners are missing, incompatible with the roof type, or cannot secure the modules correctly.
defects.spec_ref: BOM m2 (Roof attachment feet or hooks, roof-type compatible) / BOM m3 (PV module mid-clamps) / BOM m4 (PV module end-clamps) / BOM m5 (Stainless-steel mounting fastener set)
defects.check_method: Count and fit-check hardware; verify fastening and clamp engagement — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Visible scratches, dents, or uneven black finish on module frames or mounting rails; labels or printed markings are loose or misregistered.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Mounting rails and clamps) / Part p2 (PV modules)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection under D65 light at 50 cm — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

inspection_man_days.label: estimate
inspection_man_days.source_or_assumption: 125 samples at 100 units per man-day incl. functional tests

inspection_cost.label: estimate
inspection_cost.source_or_assumption: V-Trust rate (Sourced) × estimated man-days: 2 man-days (estimate) × $268/man-day (V-Trust, https://www.v-trust.com/en/our-network, checked 2026-09-26)
